extract_batch with one valid URI input and one that downloads to an unparseable document

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/text/plain.txt"), ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/corrupt_truncated.pdf")]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result.summary.results)
    print(result.summary.errors)

asyncio.run(main())
```
